## Fixes

- **Comment and alert labels on the charts no longer overlap.** Events seconds apart (an alert starting, loss, no answer) are written in up to three rows; a label that doesn't fit, or is longer than 400 points, is cut short with "…", and the full texts show when the pointer is over a mark's line or its label.
- **Switching back to another network is reported as a route change.** A return to a route seen before counted as load balancing even when the first hop (this PC's gateway) changed, so going from mobile Wi-Fi back to the cable gave no alert.
- **Russian:** a hop is called "узел".

## Known issue

- On a laptop with two graphics cards the discrete one still stays switched on while Ping Watch runs, though it doesn't draw on it. This comes from the egui library ([emilk/egui#8704](https://github.com/emilk/egui/issues/8704)) and goes away with its fix.
